propositions: The completion-verification close gate produces bare LLMError with null diagnostic when its verify step exhausts budget in a tool-call loop, instead of detecting the loop and building a verdict from fresh evidence.

The existing tool_step_limit empty-filter rewrite causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 errors (toolConfig must be defined when history contains toolUse blocks), creating a protocol violation during forced landing.

Repetition is currently detected by an inverted headline metric that fails to discriminate between healthy breadth (distinct-ratio ~0.83-0.92) and pathological k-cycles, leaving loop detection unreliable.
Budget exhaustion in CompletionAgentStep.run only catches UnretryableOutputError, so bounded recovery and repetition diagnostics are unreachable when loops occur.
Per-run request and tool-call usage is not recorded durably by default, preventing the gate from being tuned against real runaway profiles.
